description: This file defines a template class TimerType within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, which implements a timer mechanism with scheduling, triggering, revoking, and processing functionalities. It also includes a nested class for managing timed information and a thread class for timer operations. Additionally, it defines a WatchDogType class for thread-based watchdog timers.

classes.name: TimerType
classes.description: A template class implementing a timer with scheduling, triggering, revoking, and processing capabilities, including thread management.

classes.name: TimerType<CONTENT>::TimedInfo
classes.description: A helper class representing scheduled information with a timestamp and content.

classes.name: TimerType<CONTENT>::TimeWorker
classes.description: A thread class responsible for executing timer processing.

classes.name: WatchDogType
classes.description: A thread class implementing a watchdog timer with arm, reset, and worker functionalities.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a new timer event at a specified time with associated content.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all pending timer events and stops the timer thread.

methods.name: HasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific content entry is scheduled.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers a timer event immediately with specified content.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Removes a scheduled timer event associated with specific content.

methods.name: NextTrigger
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the next scheduled trigger.

methods.name: Pending
methods.description: Returns the number of pending scheduled events.

methods.name: ThreadId
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the timer thread.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Main processing loop for the timer thread, handling scheduled events.
